title: CarrierVehicleReviewed
description: One truck's review moved: sent, approved, rejected, expired or back to review after a change. `user_ids` are the organization's members, to tell them.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

status.title: VehicleStatus
status.description: The truck's own review: `none` until its papers are sent, `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, or `expired` when an approved paper ran out. Only `approved` works.

note.description: The operator's reason, or what sent the truck back to review.
